rows.acceptance_criterion: Verify the current sampling path applies the keyed transform before each committed generated token.
Prespecified independent quality and meaning evaluation on outputs from this exact configuration, with suitable precision and no hidden task failures.
Independent blinded quality comparison and watermark-status guessing with prespecified equivalence bounds and adequate precision.
Audit and replay the rendered path to show no post-added character payload, including every supported channel.
Show one sampled token per decoding step and no watermark-only output tokens; provider billing remains source-reported.
Audit key derivation, context and logs for absence of user, organization and conversation identifiers in the mark.
Verify distributed keyed choices in the actual generation path, including repeated-context handling.
Bind the actual secret-key/context implementation to reproducible public fixtures without disclosing the research secret key.
Verify context-dependent choices and categorical sampling, with exact ordinary/marked probability witnesses.
Show exact preservation of post-filter model support throughout the current implementation.
Trace the implemented transform to the pinned public reference and explain all candidate-specific choices.
Verify literal-text matching-key detection on held-out current-profile data at a calibrated operating point; retain false positives and misses.
Ensure negative or wrong-key results never imply human authorship or identify another provider.
Prespecified current-profile length study controlling model, content and operating point, with uncertainty.
Measure factual-choice capacity under the current configuration without converting a directional observation into a universal claim.
Verify copied-span protection and end-to-end proofreading fidelity on untouched tasks; independent semantic review must support the result.
Verify exact-choice preservation and code correctness while allowing choices in comments; near-point-mass behavior requires explicit treatment.
Prespecified paired current-profile serving benchmark including initialization, steady state, memory and uncertainty; define negligible before measurement.
Test light edits and genuinely full rewriting of marked sources, with independent semantic preservation and a fixed detector.
Every report and UI must describe involvement and uncertainty without asserting authorship or ownership.
Verify current-profile target-language marking and evaluate detection/quality separately across translations.
Keep keyed evidence distinct from keyless style classification in the implementation and public explanation.
Verify a single model-boundary implementation across supported generation and rendering paths.
Replay detection from copied literal text after re-tokenization across supported languages; preserve token-path ambiguities.
Ensure reports expose uncertainty, inadequate power and false positives without conclusive provenance labels.

reports.interpretation: This is an uncalibrated keyed diagnostic, not a detector verdict. It does not identify an author, owner or AI provider. Matching-key evidence from a separately calibrated detector could concern involvement in a marked generation process, including editing or translation, rather than original authorship. False positives and missed marks are possible. Short or empty text may contain too little evidence; longer text does not by itself establish power or calibration. A weak result does not establish human authorship.

shared_support_policy.scope: Exact support of the explicitly declared shared post-filter distribution; removed raw-model alternatives are not claimed preserved.
